correctness.rationale: Walsh eigenvalues 2j yield the exact rational Krawtchouk inverse and heat formula. Differencing the heat integral gives strictly positive beta integrals and exact sign-row norm. A uniform Hoeffding lower test yields the matching one-half log d minus one-half log log log d lower bound; a central-beta bound forces the true extremizer into a left Hamming tail; Hoeffding and exact product chi-square divergence then give the matching upper bound. All constants in the concentration arguments are explicit, and the proof does not extrapolate finite enumeration. The 3,810 assertion rational checker independently inverts L+J for small dimensions.

value.rationale: The Green inverse controls solutions of the discrete mean-zero Poisson equation in maximum norm. The exact operator norm measures worst-case amplification for bounded forcing; its coefficient one-half logarithm and surprisingly negative log-log-log correction are structurally motivated. The radial extremizer characterization explains why integrating an ordinary fixed-time cutoff fails to resolve this sharper stability quantity. The result is a complete natural infinite-dimensional-sequence asymptotic classification to additive constant, beyond a routine table or normalization check.
